decisions.reason: F4 incorrectly called N intersect O open for an arbitrary neighbourhood N: in R, N=[-1,1] and O=(-2,2) contradict that assertion. This is nonfatal because the closure argument only needs open N. Restricted N to open neighbourhoods. Compact cl_H(V) is ambient closed; translation places every closure point in H; the converse uses closed H intersected with a compact neighbourhood. Statement and choice-free interface are unchanged.

F3 asserted a compact neighbourhood basis in every locally compact space, contrary to the weak Definition. The stated non-Hausdorff compact Q union {p} example refutes it; a compact subset contained in Q is usual-Q compact and cannot contain a rational open interval. Step 3.1 only needs one compact neighbourhood at each point, now stated exactly. Also replaced the ambiguous inverse-composition phrase in 4.1 by m_(G/H) composed with (q times q) equals q composed with m_G, and justified openness on rectangles. Separation of cosets, local compactness and descended group operations remain valid without Choice.

Step 4.1 invokes finite subcovers of ambient open covers of compact K_(n,j). def-compact-space defines compactness intrinsically and expressly requires the missing ambient-equivalence lemma. This is a dependency-citation defect, not a counterexample to dense range. Added that existing choice-free supplier to deps and F8, synchronized its manifest and contract citation, and made local compact-neighbourhood and C_c approximation citations explicit. Orthogonality makes q times conjugate(f-hat) an L1 regular-measure density, translation kills its inverse transform, uniqueness makes it zero, and finite covers on countably many compacts kill q. Declared AC/DC cover the selections; the Statement is unchanged.

The cited standard-basis supplier defines e_i only for 0 <= i < n. Thus e_n in Example clause (1) and step 1.2 is undefined (already n=1,k=0), and ranges i<=k mix one-based proof coordinates with zero-based suppliers. Reindexed all coordinate sums and lists by 0<=i<k, used e_k for k<n, corrected F4 to e_0,...,e_(n-1), and made nondiscreteness explicit through m^(-1)e_k tending to zero. Linear-subspace annihilators follow by all real multiples; lattice annihilators by integer coordinates; quotient characters by factorization; A-transpose gives A^(-T)Z^n. The empty and full-rank boundaries remain valid and no Choice is introduced.
